desc:
Introducing Hecklor & Koch’s all new HK MR762 A4 Pistol, HK’s latest addition to their HK MR762 308 AR-10 line up. This latest HK MR762 Pistol features HK’s new two way adjustable short stroke gas piston system and new longer M-LOK Rail. Its two way adjustable gas system is marked N for Normal and S For Suppressed, both postions are optimized for use with and without a suppressor. The HK 308 Pistol is outfitted with HK’s all new 13 inch cold hammer forged cannon grade steel barrel with a standard 5/8×24 thread pitch, making it easy to add standard suppressor adapters. Hecklor & Koch did a head to head 12,000 round test between their cannon graded steel barrel and a Mil-spec chrome lined barrel. After both barrels where shot 12,000 rounds, the HK cannon grade steel barrel out performed the Mil-spec chrome lined steel barrel in both accuracy and durability. Furthermore, the Mil-Spec chrome lined barrel showed degradation, groups opened up 2.5 times larger than its starting base line and the HK cannon grade steel barrel experienced no degradation or loss in accuracy. Also, HK believes in their new cannon grade barrel so much, that it comes with HK’s lifetime barrel warranty, if you shoot out the barrel they will replace it for free.

This HK MR762 A4 Pistol’s short stroke gas piston system is designed to redirect all of the hot dirty fouling gasses out of the receivers and through the front gas block, this keeps the Rifles internals, even after prolonged rapid – full auto fire. Also, the HK MR762 pistol has fully ambidextrous controls, including its 45 degree selector, Mag Release, Bolt catch – Release. So, If your looking for the ultimate ultra compact HK 308 Pistol, look no further this new HK MR762 Pistol will check all the boxes.
